User Data Deletion Instructions

PostFlow does not store your personal data on external servers. All authentication tokens are stored locally on your device.

If you want to delete your data from PostFlow, follow these steps:

  1. Open PostFlow App Settings.
  2. Click "Disconnect" on any connected Facebook Page.
  3. Or simply clear your local browser cache / application storage.

To revoke permissions via Facebook: Go to Facebook Settings & Privacy > Settings > Business Integrations > PostFlow > Remove.
